payload.note: calendar_status="closed" is out-of-domain: gatherer-standard defines rules only for open/half_day/holiday/weekend/unknown, so evaluateCadence fell through to the unmatched 240min default. Today is Saturday; correct value "weekend" maps to 480min AND would have triggered Step 4.3 suppression of all 3 non-guaranteed slots (elapsed 4h11m < 480min => not due). Both weekend brakes bypassed by one frozen field. Root cause: Step 6.0 re-emits CALENDAR_STATUS read at Step 4.2 from the same file it rewrites - self-perpetuating, no independent calendar source. Any value written becomes the permanent freeze; "closed" preserved deliberately (over-fires) rather than writing "weekend", which would freeze suppression ON through Monday trading. Routed to PO as UC-CDC-P1 root cause.
